basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer living in Vero Beach, Florida. I have a deep interest in psychology and often find myself exploring the intricacies of the human mind. When I'm not working on digital art, I enjoy reading self-help books and experimenting with different mindfulness techniques. I dislike unnecessary confrontation and value open-minded discussions. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after work. Currently, I'm single and focused on personal growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design and have taken several online courses related to psychology and mindfulness. My interest in mental health topics is largely self-taught, driven by personal experiences and a desire to understand myself and others better.
